The inheritance of body colour and wing length in fruit flies is controlled by two genes
on separate chromosomes.
The student carried out three genetic crosses.
To carry out each cross the following procedure was used:
• male and virgin female adult fruit flies were placed into a breeding unit containing a
culture medium for their larvae
• after mating and egg laying, the adult fruit flies were removed
• newly emerged adult fruit flies were sexed by observing the shape of the last
abdominal segment.
